'''Actyallu''' was a village that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Antin Fessiq]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] ordered the troops under his command to destroy the village, claiming that the people who lived in it were aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In fact, the villagers had no connection to the Alliance, and one of the soldiers, [[Garek Tolas]], attempted to prevent the destruction of the village.
